Written to `HANDOFF.md`.

**Roll back `dep-4471`.** It set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` without raising the pool. Pool size 20 saturated 37 seconds later.

Impact ran 02:14:18Z to 03:59:27Z and is still open. 530 of 1228 requests failed. All five pooled routes hit equally.

The doc also carries the ruled-out deploys and the worker slowdown. That slowdown is a separate ticket.
